'''Clan chief''' was the title given to [[Codru-Ji]] who lead their respective clans. [[Rikkar-Du]], [[Bo-Attal]], and [[Kassek-Ka]] were all clan leaders on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]] in [[137 ABY]].
